Frequently Asked Questions

When was Barry Latman born?

Barry Latman was born on May 21, 1936.

Where was Barry Latman born?

Barry Latman was born in Los Angeles, CA.

How tall was Barry Latman?

Barry Latman was 6-3 (190 cm) tall.

How much did Barry Latman weigh when playing?

Barry Latman weighed 210 lbs (95 kg) when playing.

How many seasons did Barry Latman play?

Barry Latman played 11 seasons.

Is Barry Latman in the Hall of Fame?

Barry Latman has not been elected into the Hall of Fame.

What position did Barry Latman play?

Barry Latman was a Pitcher.

How many strikeouts did Barry Latman have?

Barry Latman had 829 strikeouts over his career.

How many teams has Barry Latman played for?

Barry Latman played for 4 teams; the California Angels, Chicago White Sox, Cleveland Indians and Houston Astros.

How many World Series has Barry Latman won?

Barry Latman never won a World Series.

When did Barry Latman retire?

Barry Latman last played in 1967.
